preconditions: OpenAI upstream returns HTTP 429 with response body/header containing resets_in_seconds
reproduction.expected: cooldown reset is derived from upstream resets_in_seconds when present
reproduction.actual: cooldown reset often uses an incorrect fallback duration instead of resets_in_seconds

progress.note: Capture bug basics and reproduction signals

progress.action: Prioritize OpenAI 429 body resets_in_seconds over x-codex header fallback and add regression test
progress.note: Root cause: handle429 checks x-codex headers before OpenAI body resets_in_seconds, so body-provided reset can be ignored.

progress.action: Verified OpenAI 429 reset uses response body resets_in_seconds before x-codex fallback
progress.note: Fix: handle429 now parses OpenAI response body resets_at/resets_in_seconds before calculateOpenAI429ResetTime(headers). Targeted regression passed: cd backend && go test ./internal/service -run TestHandle429_OpenAIPrefersBodyResetsInSecondsOverCodexHeaders -count=1

progress.action: Archive bug with automated regression test
